units: <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1">Lam. R. to I, 9</cite> <he>חד בענא וחד בב׳</he> one is employed in the fold and one in the cattle-farm.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 7:13:5">Y. Snh. VII, 25ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>גנב עגל מן בקוותא וכ׳</he> (corr. … <he>מן בקר׳ ואייתיה ליה</he>) he stole a calf from the yard and brought it to him.
